title: Prioritize Risks and Develop Remediation Plan
objective: Analyze the consolidated vulnerability matrix to prioritize risks based on exploitability and business impact, and draft specific, actionable remediation steps.
rationale: A list of vulnerabilities is useless without a plan. This task translates technical findings into prioritized, step-by-step instructions for remediation.
expected_output: A prioritized remediation plan document detailing required patches, configuration changes, and mitigation strategies.
success_criteria: All critical and high-severity vulnerabilities are assigned a specific remediation action.
The plan distinguishes between immediate fixes and long-term architectural improvements.
The plan includes estimated effort/complexity for each remediation step.
